headline: London design "an international success story" says Sadiq Khan
context: With London Design Festival underway, we asked long-standing mayor of London Sadiq Khan for his thoughts on the festival and what to see this year. Amy Peacock: Why do you believe London's design scene is worth investing in, and what role does London Design Festival play in this?
